title: My Sprite Show
body:
Goal: plan a 5-step show, then build it in the same order. Tool: Scratch app (offline). Work in pairs.

Build steps

  1. Start a new project: File > New.
  2. Click Choose a Sprite (the cat-face button at the bottom right) and pick any sprite you like. You can delete the cat: right-click it in the sprite pane and choose delete.
  3. Click Choose a Backdrop (bottom right, next to the sprites) and pick a place for your show.
  4. On paper (workbook page), write your 5 steps, one per line.
  5. Build them under when green flag clicked. Start with a go to x: y: block so the show always starts in the same place.
  6. Test with the green flag. Save as sprite-show.

The script in words (one example)

Your show will be different. Here is one idea for a sprite called Butterfly:

  • when green flag clicked
  • go to x: -150 y: 0
  • say "Welcome to my garden!" for 2 seconds
  • glide 2 secs to x: 100 y: 50
  • next costume
  • play sound (any) until done
  • say "The end!" for 2 seconds

Expected behavior

When you click the green flag, your sprite does your 5 (or more) steps in exactly the order you planned, starting from the same place every time.

Checklist

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: First, write your 5 steps on paper, one per line. Your Scratch blocks should match your paper plan in the same order. Then pick a sprite and a backdrop from the buttons at the bottom right.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: Every show starts with when green flag clicked in the Events category. Right under it, put go to x: ( ) y: ( ) from Motion, so your sprite starts in the same place every time. Then add one block for each line of your plan.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: Use a mix of blocks. Try say ( ) for ( ) seconds from Looks, glide ( ) secs to x: ( ) y: ( ) from Motion, and play sound ( ) until done from Sound. Make each speech bubble last long enough to read, and then test with the flag.
